title: Lovely Nutty Syrian Wensleydale Biryani
description: A kid-friendly Syrian dish featuring Wensleydale cheese, cooked in a tandoor and served in a scallop shell, with anti-inflammatory properties and a nutty flavor.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the chicken breast in the tandoor for 20 minutes, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add the cumin, turmeric, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Add the chopped almonds to the pan and stir for 2 minutes, or until they are lightly toasted.
Add the cooked chicken breast to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
Add the basmati rice to the pan and stir for 2 minutes, or until it is well combined with the spices and chicken.
Stir in the crumbly Wensleydale cheese.
Spoon the biryani mixture into scallop shells and serve hot.
